# Nadezhda Ibbton

Nadezhda Ibbton currently serves as Berth Scheduling Coordinator at Zorrel Analytics, a leading provider of advanced berth scheduling software that predicts optimal vessel docking times. Since joining Zorrel in 2019, Nadezhda has specialized in coordinating vessel arrivals with dock availability and tide forecasts to maximize port efficiency and minimize delays.

Her career began in 2012 at Silverline Port Authority, where she managed daily berth assignments and coordinated closely with crane operations and customs teams. In 2016, she transitioned to OceanGate Logistics, focusing on integrating real-time telemetry data into scheduling workflows.

A notable achievement during her time at Zorrel was leading the implementation of the ML-Align project in 2021, a machine learning system designed to reduce berth conflicts by 35%. This involved cross-team collaboration with data scientists, tide analysts, and terminal operators.

Nadezhda’s working style combines meticulous planning with adaptive problem-solving. She frequently partners with crane telemetry engineers and customs clearance coordinators to ensure seamless handoffs and maintain vessel throughput targets.

Current employer: [[companies/zorrel-analytics]].
